text: The prior potential U_prior is a constant potential that approximates a-priori known properties of the system, such as the Pauli exclusion principle [W3168247670#008]. It is not a Bayesian prior that biases learnable parameters in the small-data regime [W3168247670#008]. Its purpose is to control trajectory generation at the start of optimization, and it acts as a physics-informed initialization that speeds up convergence [W3168247670#008][W3168247670#010]. If it contradicts the data, the learned model term U_model corrects for it during optimization [W3168247670#008].
